cohort: 50 twin pregnancies and 50 singleton pregnancies delivered on the same day as the twin pregnancies at a private teaching hospital in India
finding: Compared to singleton pregnancies, twin pregnancies were associated with increased risk of anemia, preeclampsia, preterm labor, malpresentation, cesarean delivery, prematurity, low birth weight, congenital anomalies, prolonged NICU stay, and perinatal death.
mod_finding: Neonatal risks were higher among monochorionic twins compared to dichorionic twins.
followup_time: Neonatal period (including late neonatal deaths >7 days)
